answer: The strongest sybil defense is vested payouts: rewards are locked and released over many epochs, say 1% weekly for two years. An attacker spinning up fake identities must keep each one active and honest across every epoch to collect; flash-farming or abandoning an account forfeits its unvested share to the treasury, so attack cost scales with real time, not cheap key generation. A farmer flooding a dune of bots past the wharf of signup checks still watches most earnings evaporate, leaving a canyon between setup spending and what sybils can ever withdraw, making the attack unprofitable.
